assumptions.assumption: TSA24/BC Stage A pilot supply area is a diagnostic scale, not a TSA supply estimate.
assumptions.impact: All volumes scale linearly with this value.

assumptions.assumption: Assortment matrix rows are per-hectare values; the pilot multiplies by the diagnostic area.
assumptions.impact: Base volume is area x matrix volume; no additional yield expansion.

assumptions.assumption: Roadside cost is the assortment matrix price_cad_m3 proxy, not a harvest/stumpage cost.
assumptions.impact: Changes the profit margin; transport and processing remain explicit.

assumptions.assumption: Residue volume uses the ledger 0.45 ODT/m3 basic density and 0.45 wet-basis moisture.
assumptions.impact: Residue ODT is volume x 0.45; matrix species-specific residue_odt is not used.

assumptions.assumption: Log moisture is set to the ledger green assumption because the matrix has no log moisture field.
assumptions.impact: Only relevant if a moisture blend limit is enabled.

assumptions.assumption: m3/y infeed is used directly; odt/y infeed is converted at 1/0.45 m3 per ODT; bdmt/y is rejected.
assumptions.impact: PAP bdmt/y lines are duplicate alternatives of the m3/y log lines and are excluded.

assumptions.assumption: Facility nameplate is the sum of the maximum normalized capacity per primary product; feedstock alternatives are not additive.
assumptions.impact: Prevents counting the same FFCM line once per feedstock alternative.

assumptions.assumption: Operating cost is converted to CAD/m3 infeed with the same line's outfeed ratio when the archive unit is per mbf, kwh, admt, odt, or t.
assumptions.impact: No global mbf/kwh/admt conversion is assumed.

assumptions.assumption: Product revenue uses parsed commodity prices and each line's outfeed mix.
assumptions.impact: Mass prices are applied to odt/admt outfeed with an explicit flag.

assumptions.assumption: The TSA24 supply node has no archive route to an FFCM transload hub; a 150 km access leg is added to the minimum facility-to-TL road distance.
assumptions.impact: This is the primary transport uncertainty; it is not a Euclidean estimate.

assumptions.assumption: Road cost uses BC_logging_truck for logs and BC_residue_truck for residue, with archive fuel and operating rates.
assumptions.impact: No transload cost is applied because the diagnostic path is direct road.

assumptions.assumption: FFCM route capacity is absent from the parsed route table; pilot transport links are uncapped.
assumptions.impact: Add route capacity before interpreting congestion or rail/water limits.

assumptions.assumption: Contracts are diagnostic: min=0 and max=facility nameplate.
assumptions.impact: Contract compliance is reported but does not constrain the base pilot.

assumptions.assumption: Unassigned supply carries a diagnostic penalty so that feasible supply is not silently dropped.
assumptions.impact: The penalty is reported as a separate objective component.

assumptions.assumption: Assortment sorts are dimension-only; no BC official grade equivalence is claimed.
assumptions.impact: Grade eligibility is a feedstock-class/product screen, not a grade-quality test.

assumptions.assumption: MKRF is not used anywhere in this pilot.
assumptions.impact: No MKRF input or output is read or written.

only 8 of 179 BC facilities have coordinates in facility_geocoding.csv

no hogfuel supply in the TSA24 assortment matrix
no mill-residue (sawdust/woodchips) supply in this pilot

checks.detail: assigned + unassigned equals supply for every offer
all assignment rows reference a declared supply offer
every assignment has a declared eligible grade and transport link
no assignment exceeds a facility or grade capacity
aggregate facility assignments stay within nameplate
every unassigned row has a documented reason
facility moisture blends respect declared limits
all quantities use m3 and every capacity conversion is documented
all assignment and slack values are finite
objective decomposition reconciles to the solver objective
facility utilization rows reconcile to assignments
every contract has a compliance row
